1.intro: Play minions and use them to attack Hogger. Deal enough damage and you win!

2.intro: Expend your Mana each turn to crush this annoying gnome!

lines.start: Millhouse Manastorm is here! Prepare to be amazed!
lines.hurt: Hey, that hurt! Wait till you see my big spell!
lines.defeat: No fair! I was just getting to the good part!

3.intro: When minions fight each other, they both take damage.

lines.start: Greetings, traveler. Let us learn together.
lines.hurt: A wise move. But balance must be kept.
lines.defeat: Your skill honors the path. Go well.

4.intro: Don't understand a card? Mouse-over it!

lines.start: Mukla want bananas! You no take!
lines.hurt: Ooh ooh! Mukla call big brother!

5.intro: Kill his minions or he'll overwhelm you!

lines.start: Fresh game! Let the hunt begin!
lines.hurt: You're a tough one to bag!
lines.defeat: Well, I'll be... the hunter becomes the hunted.

6.intro: This fight is totally not fair. Blame the terrible game designers.

hints.play: Click a card in your hand to play it. Minions go on the board.
hints.attack: Click a minion that can attack, then click an enemy to attack it.
hints.end_turn: Nothing more to do? Press End Turn.
hints.mana: You get one more Mana Crystal every turn. Spend it all!
hints.raid_leader: Raid Leader gives your other minions +1 Attack.
hints.trade: Kill enemy minions before they become a problem!
hints.battlecry: A Battlecry happens when you play the card from your hand.
hints.tooltip: Hover over any card to read it.
hints.taunt: Minions with Taunt must be attacked first. Play one to protect your hero!
hints.heal: Some cards restore Health. Use them on a damaged hero or minion.
hints.buff: Some cards make your minions stronger.
hints.charge: Minions with Charge can attack right away.
hints.hero_power: Your Hero Power deals 1 damage. You can use it once per turn.
hints.weapon: Weapons let heroes attack. Each attack costs 1 Durability.

tutorial.minion_card.title: A minion card
tutorial.minion_card.text: Every card costs Mana to play. Minions also have Attack and Health.
tutorial.minion_card.mana_cost_what: Mana cost: what it takes to play the card
tutorial.combat.title: Combat
tutorial.combat.text: When minions fight, each deals its Attack as damage to the other. A minion with 0 Health dies.
tutorial.heroes.title: Heroes
tutorial.heroes.text: Your hero has 30 Health. Attack the enemy hero with your minions: bring it to 0 Health to win!
tutorial.mana.title: Mana
tutorial.mana.text: You get one more Mana Crystal every turn, up to 10. Playing a card spends its cost. Try to spend all your Mana every turn!
tutorial.spells.title: Spells
tutorial.spells.text: A spell does its effect once and is gone. Millhouse loves spells! A Frozen character misses its next attack.
tutorial.battlecry.title: Battlecry
tutorial.battlecry.text: A Battlecry happens once, when you play the card from your hand.
tutorial.minions_first.title: Minions first
tutorial.minions_first.text: While Cho has minions, he can't be attacked. Damage stays on a minion until it is healed, so finish them off!
tutorial.taunt.title: Taunt
tutorial.taunt.text: Enemies must attack a minion with Taunt before anything else. Put one in front of your hero!
tutorial.charge.title: Charge
tutorial.charge.text: A minion can't attack on the turn it is played. Minions with Charge can attack right away.
tutorial.charge.played_this_turn: Played this turn: has to wait
tutorial.deathrattle.title: Deathrattle
tutorial.deathrattle.text: A Deathrattle happens when the minion dies. King Mukla's barrels hide surprises: break one to see what's inside!
tutorial.hero_power.title: Hero Power
tutorial.hero_power.text: Every hero has a Hero Power. It costs 2 Mana and can be used once each turn.
tutorial.freeze.title: Freeze
tutorial.freeze.text: A Frozen character misses its next attack. Freeze Hemet's hunters and kill them before they swarm you!
tutorial.weapons.title: Weapons
tutorial.weapons.text: A weapon lets a hero attack. Illidan wields warglaives! A hero who attacks a minion takes damage back.
tutorial.weapons.attack_damage_hero: Attack: the damage the hero deals
tutorial.weapons.durability_drops_by: Durability: drops by 1 with each attack; at 0 the weapon breaks
tutorial.putting_it_all_together.title: Putting it all together
tutorial.putting_it_all_together.text: Illidan is strong. Use everything you have learned: guard your hero with Taunt and clear his minions with spells.
tutorial.putting_it_all_together.his_hero_power: His Hero Power: two minions every turn
